rootCause.observation: A Worker launched with an explicit working-tree Pi Team Bright extension also discovered a distinct installed Pi Team Bright extension. Pi reported conflicts for task_read, task_update, and alert_send. The launched Pi exited, and Herdr returned agent_name_not_found.
rootCause.owningInvariant: One Worker process loads exactly one Pi Team Bright extension source. Ambient Skills and proxy environment are not Worker-launch inputs.
rootCause.repair: Worker argv uses -ns -ne -e <exact-source>. Herdr forwards only PI_* identity variables. The first Herdr split rounds the requested leader share up from the measured pane width.
